tools.name: list_developer_products
tools.description: List the developer products for a Roblox universe (game). Returns each item's ID, name, price, description, and on-sale status. Use this to see a game's developer products or to find an ID before updating one.

maxPageSize.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

pageToken.description: Token from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tools.name: get_developer_product
tools.description: Get the full details of a single developer product by its ID within a universe.

tools.name: create_developer_product
tools.description: Create a new developer product in a universe. Only a name is required. To make it purchasable, also pass priceInRobux and isForSale: true — it cannot be put on sale without a price. Returns the created developer product including its new ID. Requires an API key scoped to write developer products.

name.description: The developer product name shown to buyers.

priceInRobux.description: Price in Robux. Required before it can be sold.

isForSale.description: Whether it is available for purchase. Requires a price.

imagePath.description: Icon image to upload: a local file path (e.g. C:\icons\gem.png or /home/me/gem.png), a file:// URL, or an https:// URL to a .png or .jpg. Uploaded images go through Roblox moderation before they appear.

tools.name: update_developer_product
tools.description: Update an existing developer product's name, description, price, or on-sale status. Only the fields you provide change. Putting it on sale (isForSale: true) requires a price. Returns the updated developer product. Requires an API key scoped to write developer products.

productId.description: The developer product ID to update.

isForSale.description: Put on sale (true) or off sale (false). Selling requires a price.

imagePath.description: Icon image to upload: a local file path (e.g. C:\icons\gem.png or /home/me/gem.png), a file:// URL, or an https:// URL to a .png or .jpg. Uploaded images go through Roblox moderation before they appear.

tools.name: bulk_create_developer_products
tools.description: Create many developer products in one call. Use this instead of calling create_developer_product repeatedly. Items are created sequentially with automatic rate limiting (the API allows 3 writes/second). Returns a summary plus a per-item result (created 'id' or error); one failing item does not stop the rest.

name.description: The developer product name shown to buyers.

priceInRobux.description: Price in Robux. Required before it can be sold.

isForSale.description: Whether it is for sale. Requires a price.

imagePath.description: Icon image to upload: a local file path (e.g. C:\icons\gem.png or /home/me/gem.png), a file:// URL, or an https:// URL to a .png or .jpg. Uploaded images go through Roblox moderation before they appear.

tools.name: bulk_update_developer_products
tools.description: Update many developer products in one call. Use this instead of calling update_developer_product repeatedly. Each entry targets one by ID and changes only the fields you provide. Items are updated sequentially with automatic rate limiting (3 writes/second). Returns a summary plus a per-item result; one failing item does not stop the rest.

productId.description: The developer product ID to update.

isForSale.description: Put on sale (true) or off sale (false). Selling requires a price.

imagePath.description: Icon image to upload: a local file path (e.g. C:\icons\gem.png or /home/me/gem.png), a file:// URL, or an https:// URL to a .png or .jpg. Uploaded images go through Roblox moderation before they appear.

updates.description: The developer product updates to apply.
